name: Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful rice dish with spiced chicken, a Pakistani staple.
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Parboil rice, layer with marinated chicken in a pot.
Cook on dum with ghee and saffron, serve hot.

name: Karahi Chicken
description: A spicy chicken curry cooked in a traditional karahi.
instructions: Heat oil, add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes.
Add chicken and spices, cook until oil separates.
Garnish with green chilies, serve with naan.

name: Mutton Korma
description: A rich mutton curry with creamy gravy.
instructions: Fry onions until golden, add mutton and spices.
Cook with yogurt until tender, garnish with almonds.
Serve with rice or roti.

name: Aloo Gosht
description: A hearty mutton and potato curry.
instructions: Cook mutton with spices until half-done.
Add cubed potatoes, simmer until tender.
Serve with naan or rice.

name: Pulao
description: Fragrant rice with meat and spices.
instructions: Fry onions, add beef and spices, cook until tender.
Add soaked rice and water, cook until done.
Serve hot.

name: Qeema
description: Minced meat cooked with peas and spices.
instructions: Cook minced meat with tomatoes and spices.
Add peas, simmer until soft.
Serve with paratha.

name: Dal Chawal
instructions: Cook lentils with tomatoes and spices.
Prepare plain rice separately.
Serve together with a side of pickle.

name: Chicken Pulao
description: A simpler version of biryani with chicken.
instructions: Fry onions, add chicken and spices.
Add soaked rice and water, cook until rice is done.
Serve warm.

name: Saag Gosht
description: Mutton cooked with spinach for a healthy twist.
instructions: Cook mutton with spices until tender.
Add blended spinach, simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve with roti.

name: Keema Naan
description: Stuffed naan with spiced minced meat.
instructions: Prepare dough, mix minced meat with spices.
Stuff dough with meat, roll and cook on tawa with ghee.
Serve hot.
